evidence_status: Independent .9 corpus v3 is frozen before candidate outputs. No acceptable independent candidate report exists; null pins prevent release.
artifact_location: Operator may set BP5_ACCEPTANCE_ARTIFACT_ROOT to a local directory containing the exact evaluated Linux artifacts. This private location is not report identity; every declared artifact hash must still match. model_root remains null in the public contract.
trust_boundary: The canonical repository contract is updated by the coordinating implementation workflow after verifying independent evaluation artifacts. This prevents accidental or stale completion, not forgery by a trusted repository editor. No human approval step is introduced.
corpus_rotation: For a new independently frozen corpus, preserve the old corpus/report privately, replace active_corpus SHA, metadata SHA, exact counts and independent evaluator identity, and reset accepted_report_sha256 to null. Never reuse a disclosed corpus as a fresh holdout. Pin a new report only after the independent evaluator runs the entire new corpus against immutable candidate bytes and results pass this gate.
